=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24299-24318 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate`, after the gate returns `pr_not_merged`, the code fetches the source PR again (`_ctg_source_json="$(_fetch_pr_json "${_CT_GATE_PR}")"`) but reads only `.head.ref`; it never checks the fresh `.state` or `.merged` fields.
  WHY: If the source PR is reopened or merged between the gate's verdict and this fetch, the poller still labels the triage issue `ai:closed` and closes it as "not planned" based on a stale verdict. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT; minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity. The highest was used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24331-24370 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "source PR closed without merging" path in `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` (cross-reference loop → `ensure_label_exists "ai:closed"` → `gh issue close --reason "not planned"`) holds the issue open only when an open, same-repository `ai/issue-<n>` PR is on the timeline. It never consults `issue_has_active_workflow` (line 18727, backed by `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES`) to detect an in-flight pipeline run.
  WHY: A triage issue in `ai:planning` or `ai:implementing`, or one just re-dispatched, whose run has not opened its fix PR yet can be closed as not planned. The run then opens a PR against a closed issue, which orphans in-flight work, as AD-1 option B forbids.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5848-5855 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Before closing an issue as "not planned", `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` checks only for an open, same-repository `ai/issue-<n>` PR on the timeline; it never checks whether a pipeline run for the issue is still in flight.
  WHY: An `ai:planning` or `ai:implementing` issue whose run has not opened its fix PR yet can be labelled `ai:closed` and closed, which orphans in-flight work. The reviewer stated no severity, so high was used to match the finding above, which has the same root cause; it is listed separately because its line range does not overlap.
- tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py:4235-4268 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate on head 3b62d09 attributes 4 failing test files to this change, including `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py`, which this PR modifies. `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` timed out and is unverified, and the head's `lint` and `readiness` check-runs were cancelled.
  WHY: Either the PR ships with a failing test file or the gate mis-attributes the failures; either way the new poller behaviour has not run on the head commit. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 traced the code and report no defect behind these failures, calling them pre-existing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5518-5530 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comment above `close_merged_issues_sweep()` says every issue is reached "within ceil(total/cap) ticks", but offsets `(GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER * cap) % total` cycle through `total/gcd(cap, total)` values (cap=10, total=15 gives 3, not 2).
  WHY: There is no runtime defect, but operators sizing `CHECK_TRIAGE_GATE_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK` would under-estimate convergence time. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 dispute this: coverage takes ceil(total/cap) consecutive windows.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "In the poll, run `check_triage_resolution.py gate` over open `ai:check-triage` issues in any phase (including `ai:blocked`, `ai:needs-human`, and never-started), and close them when the result is `resolved` / `already_resolved`." (issue #9481, "Proposed fix" bullet 3)
  expected_change_site: the `STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY` idle/no-tracking branch of scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 28327-28330), also the `UNBLOCK_SCAN_SWEEP_ONLY` branch (lines 28308-28319), and/or the no-tracking has_work probe in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 411-423)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The gate pass exists only inside `close_merged_issues_sweep`, which is called only from the full poller's post-loop block (line 35378; call site 5854), the `STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY` branch at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:28327-28330 runs `run_standalone_stall_recovery` and exits before the sweep, `UNBLOCK_SCAN_SWEEP_ONLY` at 28308-28319 runs `run_unblock_scan` and exits (both are set at .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1701 and 1755), the no-tracking probe at .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:411-423 checks only `ai:clarification`, `ai:planning`, `ai:awaiting-approval`, `ai:implementing`, `ai:done`, `ai:ready-to-merge` and `ai:review-blocked` plus two comment markers, not `ai:check-triage`, `ai:blocked` or `ai:needs-human`, the stall-path gate invocation at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24157 handles only merged-into-non-target-base, and no diff hunk touches either site. So the #828/#820/#722 and btc_sweeper#207 shapes are never gated on repos with no active tracking issue. The workflow file is outside the plan grant.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_close_sweep_check_triage_gate (source-PR-closed close path: cross-reference loop, ensure_label_exists "ai:closed", gh issue edit --add-label "ai:closed", gh issue close --reason "not planned") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The close path checks only for an open, same-repository `ai/issue-<n>` PR cross-referenced on the timeline. It never checks `issue_has_active_workflow` (line 18727). `ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_ISSUES` is built in `run_standalone_stall_recovery` (line 25589), which runs before `close_merged_issues_sweep` (lines 35370 and 35378).
  WHY: An issue in plan or implement, or one just re-dispatched, whose run has not opened its PR is labelled `ai:closed` and closed, and the running job can still open a PR for it. AD-1 option B forbids this. Suggested fix: guard with issue_has_active_workflow and log reason=source_pr_closed_unmerged_run_active.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_close_sweep_check_triage_gate (`_ctg_source_json="$(_fetch_pr_json "${_CT_GATE_PR}")"` followed only by jq -er '.head.ref | strings') | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_fetch_pr_json` (line 2534) is an uncached read whose payload includes `state` and `merged`, but only `head.ref` is read.
  WHY: If the PR is reopened or merged in the window, the issue is still closed as "not planned". Suggested fix: require `.state == "closed"` and `.merged != true` in the same jq call.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "In the poll, run check_triage_resolution.py gate over open ai:check-triage issues in any phase (including ai:blocked, ai:needs-human, and never-started), and close them when the result is resolved / already_resolved."
  Expected change site: the idle-tick STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY block of scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 28327-28331) or the no-tracking has_work probe in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 411-423). The workflow file is outside the plan grant.
  Evidence of absence: The gate pass is only in close_merged_issues_sweep, which is called only at line 35378. The probe omits ai:check-triage, ai:blocked and ai:needs-human, and the sweep-only branch exits at line 28330, so #820/#722/#828-shaped issues are never gated. No diff hunk touches either site.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Hardening suggestions (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2): check the source PR's state/merged flag via jq select (1 line); add the issue_has_active_workflow guard before ensure_label_exists "ai:closed" (4 lines); reword the close_merged_issues_sweep header comment to "within ceil(total/cap) consecutive run numbers that reach this sweep", because idle, sweep-only and cancelled runs also consume run numbers (1 line). (3 related items)
- Checked and not reported: the tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py pre-push failure (no code defect found in _linked_pr_evidence / resolve_label_repair_evidence, scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 1867-1908 and 2128-2205); the pass-1 rotation nit (wrong: ceil(total/cap) consecutive windows cover every issue); the stall guard skipping the gate (an already-merged PR is still reconciled at lines 26000 and 26062, before invoke_stall_judge at line 26318). (3 related items)
